text: You don't have a healing potion on you, do you?
zh: 你身上不会正好带着生命药水吧？
拿着这瓶弱效生命药水吧。
拿着这瓶小型生命药水吧。
拿着这瓶标准生命药水吧。

text: Sorry, I don't have a healing potion on me.
zh: 抱歉，我身上没有生命药水。

text: I was curious what lies inside these ruins, and snuck my way through the undead.
zh: 我好奇这遗迹里藏着什么，就从亡灵堆里偷偷摸了进来。

text: Eventually, I stumbled upon a monstrosity lurking down here.
zh: 结果，我撞见了一头潜伏在下面的怪物。

text: I tried to take it down, but it overwhelmed me. One blow, and I knew it was time to retreat.
zh: 我想干掉它，却被它压着打。只挨了一下，我就知道该撤了。

text:
Ahh, fuck!
Hopefully, I'll survive this round.
zh:
啊，妈的！
但愿这回我能挺过去。

text:
Thank you!
This will definitely help to defeat that monstrosity.
zh:
谢谢你！
有了这个，肯定能帮我干掉那头怪物。
